title: 雪夜山庄
blurb_en: Seven guests are trapped by snow at a mountain inn. The owner is found dead in the woodshed, and the only footprints are small ones leading back to the inn. They are the narrator's size.
blurb_zh: 大雪封山，七个客人被困在山庄里。老板死在了柴房，雪地上只有一行脚印，从柴房走回山庄。那双脚印，跟她的鞋一样大。
